summary: Mobix Labs issued a senior secured convertible promissory note to Leviston Resources for $1,000,000 (original principal $1.2M) under an investor rights agreement and third amendment to a March 2026 securities purchase agreement. The note bears 10% interest, matures December 25, 2026, and is convertible into Class A common stock at the lower of closing price or 85% of lowest 8-day VWAP. Event of default triggers 125% payoff. This is a distressed financing, not a classic special situation. Watch for conversion dilution and potential going-concern risk.
